subtitle: Family scam safety practice
promotionalText: Prepare before a scam reaches your family. Practice seven short lessons, review current guidance, Check suspicious messages, and follow through with people you trust.
shortDescription: Practice safer responses, Check suspicious messages, and coordinate with family.
fullDescription: BoomerBuddy helps adults and families prepare for and respond to suspicious messages, links, payment requests, and impersonation attempts. Practice seven short safety lessons, review dated source-linked guidance, and use a weekly rehearsal to make pausing and independently verifying feel familiar. When something suspicious arrives, submit text or a URL for a structured Check of warning signs, uncertainty, and safer next steps. Keep a private 30-day history, deliberately share a redacted result with an authorized Trusted Circle member, and use a private Family Safe Word as one social verification aid. BoomerBuddy reviews only what you submit. It does not open websites, monitor messages, guarantee safety, send alerts to family automatically, prove identity, or replace emergency services, a financial institution, law enforcement, or qualified professional advice. Access is invitation-only during early release.

prerequisites: Install the exact signed IPA or AAB identified by the release receipt.
Confirm the live API and Customer Clerk realm match that release receipt.
Preflight the same non-expiring synthetic review account against the required role, household, capabilities, canonical access, allowances, and every listed flow.
Deliver reusable account access only through each provider's secure review fields. Never place credentials or one-time codes in the repository, receipt, prompt, screenshot, or log.

steps.instruction: Open BoomerBuddy, choose Member sign in, complete hosted customer authentication, and confirm the browser returns to the app.
On Home, confirm the synthetic protected-adult household, current canonical access summary, allowances, and required capabilities.
Open Check, enter approved synthetic text or a reserved-domain URL manually, and review the warning signs and safer next steps.
Open History and confirm only the signed-in synthetic household records are visible.
Open Family and Orientation to review explicit roles, permissions, consent, and recovery guidance.
Open Learn and updates, review one lesson and current source-linked guidance, verify weekly practice status, and confirm any device reminder is optional and generic.
Open Help and policies, Support, Privacy, Terms, Accessibility, and Account deletion from the app.
Restart the app, confirm secure session restoration, sign out, and confirm protected content is no longer available.
Confirm that mobile shows access status only and offers no checkout, pricing, billing link, native purchase, or payment steering.

knownUnavailableFeatures: Public sign-up is not offered during invitation-only early release.

Retain artifact hash, device class, operating-system version, locale, text scale, screen-reader state, and UTC capture time in the release receipt.
